_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Sunday — closing bracket on W15 + open-weight ecosystem as day's centre of gravity. (1) MiniMax releases MMX-CLI on top of Saturday's M2.7 weights — Node.js CLI giving AI agents native access to image/video/speech/music/vision/search via MiniMax platform; built to be invoked by other agents in Cursor/Claude Code/OpenCode harnesses, not just by humans; clearest 'model + tool-server packaged for invocation by other agents' pattern yet — agent-to-agent invocation pattern defining Q3 plumbing. (2) MiniMax M2.7 trends to #1 on HuggingFace alongside Gemma 4 — 'open weights' framing fragments into Apache-2.0 / OpenRAIL / commercial-restricted, Apache-2.0 becoming the minority. (3) Bloomberg Opinion 'Anthropic Sets the Right AI Standard with Mythos' preview Sunday (formal publication Monday) — Glasswing template (capability disclosure + access gating + 11-partner defender consortium) becomes operating template policymakers will cite for future frontier-AI dual-use disclosures; closing bracket on most-consequential AI policy week of 2026. (4) HF Spring 2026 State of Open Source recap — Chinese-developed models 41% of Q1 2026 HF download volume; robotics datasets 23× year-over-year (1,145 → 26,991); AGIBOT World 2026 open-source dataset for embodied AI adds to 23× narrative. (5) Mistral 3 schedule confirmed for late April; Cloud Next '26 Pichai pre-keynote interview — Cloud Next opens 22 April, sets agentic-era / 8th-gen TPU narrative. Research (Sunday backfill from Friday cohort, deduped): SkillClaw (third corner of agent-skills design space between SKILL0 in-weight and Graph-of-Skills inference-time retrieval); MolmoWeb (state-of-the-art among open-weight web agents — direct counter-pressure to closed CUA stacks); KnowU-Bench (mobile agents drop below 50% on vague instructions requiring user-preference inference); Beyond Stochastic Exploration / HiExp; Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT; Mnemonic Sovereignty survey on persistent-memory threats. Blogs: Suresh Kumar Ariya Gowder 'Prompt Engineering Is Dead. Long Live Context Engineering' — cleanest reframing of prompt → context engineering shift the week was building toward.

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: Depth Ceiling — LLMs execute latent reasoning at varying depths but consistently fail to discover the right multi-step planning strategies — discovery and execution dissociate. Direct evidence that CoT-monitoring captures execution but not strategy selection. MARS multi-token AR generation. SEVerA Formally Guarded Generative Models with first-order-logic specifications + Dafny verification.

New topic 'wall-street-mythos-briefings' spawns. Holland & Knight EU AI Act August deadline + IAPP machinery-rules amendments add the European regulatory side. Anthropic + Blackstone enterprise services thesis builds; CoreWeave $35B Meta backlog visible.
